title: Implement mobile session navigation and recents UX improvements
Research current recents, session listing, path explorer, and mobile navigation code/tests
Plan UX implementation slices and identify blockers
Add host/client support for browsing sessions for a selected path
Rework connection/home UI for recents management, session browsing, and Documents shortcut
Add lightweight mobile navigation refinements from proposal

content: Starting research for implementation. Focus: existing client-history helpers/tests, HostClient session list support, App.tsx connection/path explorer wiring, and README flow docs.

observation: Recent history is stored entirely on-device in AsyncStorage with helper functions for load/save/remember. Sessions are deduped by normalized host URL + cwd, making deletion by host/path straightforward.
Client history has focused unit tests for normalization, dedupe, limits, malformed storage, and round-trip persistence; deletion helpers should be covered here.

HostClient already exposes listSessions(cwd), listDirectories(path), and openSession(request). Browsing sessions for a path can be implemented mostly in the app UI using the existing API, with an added client test.

HostController.listSessions currently normalizes cwd with path.resolve, while directory browsing expands '~'. To support session browsing for '~/Documents' directly, listSessions should reuse the host-path resolver.

connectToHost currently browses directories with the default path '~' after host status succeeds. This is the place to switch the explorer default to '~/Documents' and optionally seed the selected cwd from that resolved directory unless the user typed an absolute path.

The connection UI can implement a recents-first mobile home without a navigation dependency by adding local setup-expanded state and only showing manual host/path panels when there are no recents or the user taps a browse/setup action.
The HTTP server already routes GET /api/sessions?cwd=, so no new endpoint is needed for browsing sessions by path; tests can cover the existing route if useful.

content: Research complete. The implementation can use existing host /api/sessions support, add client-side deletion helpers, expand tilde normalization for host session listing, and update the connection UI into a recents-first home with collapsible setup, Documents-default browsing, and a sessions-for-path panel.
Planning implementation slices and checking whether the requested UX needs new protocol fields or human clarification.

Implementation plan:

1. Add `forgetHost` and `forgetSession` to client-history with tests. Deleting a host will also remove recent sessions from that host so client history stays concise.
2. Add failing/focused tests for HostClient.listSessions URL encoding and HostController.listSessions tilde expansion; update HostController to reuse resolveHostPath for cwd filters.
3. In App.tsx add state and actions for sessions listed for the currently selected/browsed path, plus open-listed-session handling that opens a stored `sessionFile` and remembers it.
4. Switch default directory browse path to `~/Documents`, add Home and Documents shortcut buttons, and seed cwd to resolved Documents after connect unless the user already entered an absolute path.
5. Rework ConnectionScreen into a recents-first mobile home: recent sessions and hosts appear first with delete actions; manual connect/workspace/path/session browser panels live behind a setup/browse toggle when recents exist.
6. Update README flow/API notes and run focused plus full validation.

No blocker or human clarification is required: the existing GET /api/sessions?cwd= API and SessionSummary.sessionFile are sufficient to continue desktop sessions from mobile.
Plan recorded with no blockers. Proceeding with TDD-style focused tests before implementation.
Starting client-history deletion helpers with tests first.

observation: Client-history tests initially failed because forgetHost/forgetSession were not implemented, then passed after adding the deletion helpers: 5 files, 35 tests.

content: Added `forgetHost` and `forgetSession` client-history helpers. Host deletion removes both the recent host row and sessions for that host; session deletion removes the host/path session row while preserving the host. Focused client-history tests pass.
Starting session-browsing support. Adding focused tests for HostClient.listSessions URL encoding and HostController tilde expansion before changing host normalization.

observation: New tilde-expansion test failed when HostController.listSessions used path.resolve('~/Documents'), then passed after switching list/open cwd normalization to resolveHostPath. Host focused suite passed: 4 files, 17 tests.
HostClient listSessions URL-encoding coverage passes; app focused suite reported 5 files, 36 tests.

content: Added HostClient listSessions coverage and host tilde-expansion coverage. HostController now expands ~/ paths for session listing and session open normalization, so ~/Documents can be used consistently for directory and session browsing.
Starting App.tsx UI/data-flow update for recents deletion, sessions-for-path browsing, Documents default, and Documents shortcut.

observation: Connection screen now promotes recent sessions before hosts, adds Delete actions to both recent sections, collapses manual host/path setup behind a Browse host/path panel when history exists, defaults directory browsing to ~/Documents, and includes Home/Documents/Up shortcuts.

The app now maintains sessions-for-path state, auto-loads sessions when browsing directories, exposes a Browse sessions/Refresh control for the selected path, and opens listed stored sessions by sessionFile so desktop sessions can be continued from mobile.
Added isHostWorkspacePath so ~/ paths are treated as intentional host workspace paths and preserved across connect, while relative paths still seed from host cwd.

content: Reworked the connection/home UI to support requested recents management and session browsing: recent sessions first, delete actions for hosts/sessions, Documents default and shortcut, sessions-for-selected-path browser, and open stored session by sessionFile. Focused app tests and mobile typecheck pass.
Reviewing the implemented connection screen changes against the earlier phone-navigation proposal.

Implemented the lightweight navigation slice from the proposal without adding a navigation dependency: the connection screen is now recents-first, manual setup is collapsed behind a Browse host/path action when history exists, and folder/session browsing is task-oriented rather than a single always-visible form column.
Starting README updates and final validation.

observation: Docs now describe the recents-first mobile home, local delete actions for recent hosts/sessions, ~/Documents default browsing with Home/Documents shortcuts, and browsing/continuing stored sessions for a selected path.
Initial root validation failed because root scripts invoked `pnpm` but the shell only had `corepack`; running `corepack enable` installed the pnpm shim at /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/pnpm.
